title: The master session's sandbox allows only its own work, including host add
description: Under real bubblewrap confinement, the master session cannot edit tracked checkout files, forge conversation records, or touch host process-launch channels or other machine files, while its managed state, peer grants, and `graphyard host add` for a prepared host succeed and record the host key in the install's machine/known_hosts file.

steps.name: Master session confinement allows only its work, including host add
